verdicts.reason: The two candidates look pixel-identical, so they share the same flaws. The wind-turbine icon, which is the hero image in the original, has shrunk to a tiny glyph and sits wedged between the green, blue and red triangles. Those triangles are cramped into an awkward strip along the top edge. The headline is oversized and crowds the left and bottom edges, which buries the imagery and reverses the original's icon-first hierarchy. The stray diagonal lines float at random on the right.
